text:
The Free Fees Initiative covers tuition for eligible students on a first undergraduate degree, and students still pay an annual student contribution on top, plus a smaller institutional levy. It is the largest predictable cost of an Irish degree after accommodation, and the name of the scheme actively conceals it.

The second thing the name hides is who qualifies. Eligibility depends on residence history in the EEA as well as on citizenship, so an EU passport does not settle it by itself. Both are worth checking against your own circumstances before Ireland goes on a shortlist as the free option.
attribution: The Higher Education Authority’s description of the Free Fees Initiative
